claim: The demo opens with three fictional draft tickets, expires after 24 hours, and leaves real classes unchanged.
where: landing action, demo banner, privacy, README
sandbox: seed a real session and browser key; enter and reset /?demo=1; assert three records, 24-hour expiry, isolated storage, and unchanged real data

claim: Teachers can export the full session as CSV.
sandbox: fresh demo workspace; download CSV and assert its header and three rows

claim: Teachers share a six-character session code; students use a class nickname and record four drafting checkpoints.
sandbox: fresh class; create a session, submit all four fields, and verify them in the teacher view

claim: Teachers choose one, seven, or thirty days before a session expires and is deleted.
sandbox: fresh API sessions; assert one-, seven-, and thirty-day deletion times, then use the debug-only accelerated clock and observe expiry cleanup

claim: Free sessions accept up to 40 draft tickets.
sandbox: fresh API session; create 40 tickets and assert ticket 41 is rejected

claim: The app uses no webcam, microphone, keystroke logging, analytics, or third-party tracking; session requests stay on this service.
sandbox: fresh student form; type in every field and assert no request or browser-storage change, then submit through an exact same-origin path allowlist; stub media capture

claim: The database stores only class content, random record IDs, hashed teacher credentials, timestamps, demo markers, rate-limit hash material, and rate counters deleted within four seconds; expired sessions delete their tickets.
sandbox: fresh SQLite database; inspect every table and column, migrate a legacy credential, assert hashed values and 24-hour demo expiry, then run cleanup and assert cascade deletion

claim: The app does not detect AI use, prove authorship, or judge who wrote a draft.
sandbox: fresh demo; complete the sample read path, assert the boundary copy and absence of detection controls, and reject unimplemented detection endpoints

claim: There is no paid plan; teachers and students can complete the core workflow without an account or payment.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; create a class, submit a ticket, and read it as the teacher while asserting no sign-in, checkout, or payment request occurs

claim: Only the private teacher link can read, export, or delete a session.
sandbox: fresh API session; reject unauthenticated read, CSV export, and deletion, then accept all three with the private token

claim: PORT defaults to 8080; local SQLite uses mounted /data or ./data, and DATA_DIR and DATABASE_URL are optional overrides.
sandbox: local Rust unit test with a temporary durable directory and no external service; assert port, path, SQLite default, and PostgreSQL override selection

claim: GET /health returns the build SHA and selected storage backend without cache reuse.
sandbox: fresh local browser project; request health with a nonce and assert its build identity, storage backend, and no-store cache policy

claim: The release gate rejects a latest revision that is not ready, lacks the PostgreSQL secret, or permits more than one replica.
sandbox: local contract fixture for the exact unhealthy Azure revision reported by verification 19; no cloud service or release action is contacted
